text:
anya_support: FYI customer reported they can't open Billing > Usage for tenant acme-inc. Console shows a 403 when fetching the encrypted billing key. Customer says they were kicked out after yesterday's KMS rotation.

jenna_support: forwarding the customer's logs: 
`GET /v1/tenants/acme/billing/key` -> 403 {"error":"permission_denied","reason":"access denied to KMS key"} 
Customer timestamp: 2025-11-02T08:12:03Z

anya_support: tagging infra: @devon_sre can you confirm whether the rotation job updated service-account IAM for the new key alias? :rotating_light:

devon_sre: looking. I see rotation completed at 2025-11-02T06:45:10Z. The rotation job created alias `redwood/acme/billing-key-v2` and updated Customer KMS metadata, but it didn't patch the internal service principal binding due to a race in the sync script. Investigating.

liam_security: from audit log (auditbot): 
`auditbot: KMS: KeyAccessDenied: principal redwood-infra-sa tried to GetKey but lacked kms.cryptoKeys.get` 
Looks like the grant for `redwood-infra-sa` wasn't applied to the new key resource.

devon_sre: repro locally with the same alias -> `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy redwood_acme_billing_key_v2` returns a policy with no binding for `serviceAccount:redwood-infra-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The rotation step that copies IAM bindings failed with exit 0 but without updating because the helper returned empty permissions set.

anya_support: customer's blocked from viewing invoices. They need access ASAP. Jenna, please tell them we're escalating and will restore a temporary fix.

jenna_support: messaged customer: "We're escalating to SRE + Security. Temporary fix in progress; will update within 30m." :white_check_mark:

devon_sre: temp fix plan: 1) copy IAM bindings from old key to new key 2) force re-encrypt of billing metadata so fetch uses new key correctly 3) invalidate session caches for billing UI tokens. Doing step 1 now.

devon_sre: Command used:
```bash
OLD=redwood_acme_billing_key_v1
NEW=redwood_acme_billing_key_v2
POLICY=$(gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy "$OLD" --format=json)
echo "$POLICY" | gcloud kms keys set-iam-policy "$NEW" --policy-file=-
```
Applied. Returned binding count 3.

liam_security: re-run audit check: `auditbot: GrantAdded: serviceAccount:redwood-infra-sa kms.cryptoKeys.get on key redwood_acme_billing_key_v2`

devon_sre: step 2 re-encrypt job started via internal tool `recrypt-billing` with flag `--tenant acme-inc --key-alias redwood/acme/billing-key-v2`. Job logs show success for all objects.

deploy-bot: deploy job finished: recrypt-billing v1.4.2 -> success (2025-11-02T08:36:12Z)

devon_sre: step 3: clearing Redis prefix `billing_token:acme-inc:*` and bumping cache version.

jenna_support: told customer to try again. They report Billing > Usage loads and invoices visible. They also confirm downloads work.

anya_support: closing the immediate incident. We'll do root cause + remediation items.

liam_security: root cause summary: KMS rotation helper skipped IAM copy for the new key when external IAM returns an empty set (edge case). That left `redwood-infra-sa` without kms access. This manifests as 403s for all billing key fetches.

devon_sre: action items I've created: RW-1192 "fix kms rotation IAM copy race" (high), RW-1193 "add post-rotation IAM verification and test", RW-1194 "runbook: tenant-facing KMS rotation rollback and temp-access steps".

jenna_support: added a follow-up note to the customer's ticket summarizing fix and an apology.

liam_security: also setting a short retention/alert: any KMS key creation/alias events that don't have expected service-account bindings within 5m should fire a P1 to #eng-oncall.

anya_support: thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
